### Sensitivity Analysis (Sequential Ignorability)

The SEM mediation models above identify the indirect effect under **sequential
ignorability**: no unmeasured confounding of the mediator (`Sureness_Diff`) -
outcome path, over and above random assignment of condition. This is not
guaranteed by randomization (only the condition -> mediator and condition ->
outcome paths are), and is typically implausible on its face. Following Imai,
Keele, & Yamamoto (2010), we assess how large an unobserved mediator-outcome
confound (parameterized as a residual correlation, rho, between the mediator
and outcome equations) would have to be to drive the indirect effect to zero.
rho = 0 reproduces the models above; the "tipping point" rho* is the value at
which the indirect effect crosses zero. A small |rho*| means a small amount of
unobserved confounding would overturn the result; a large |rho*| means the
result is robust to all but implausibly large confounding.

```{r save mediation results for supplement, include=FALSE}
# Path estimates for Supplement Table E1 (5-disseminate/supplement.qmd reads this file).
# NB: the fits above use 10,000 bootstrap draws each, so this script takes over an hour; the saved file only changes
# when this script is re-run.
med_fits <- c("fit_det", "fit_det.s1", "fit_pers.s1", "fit_det.s2", "fit_detcd.s2", "fit_limcd.s2")
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(
  params_2020 = setNames(mget(paste0(med_fits, "_params")), med_fits),
  params_2024 = setNames(mget(paste0(med_fits, "_params.2024")), med_fits),
  n = vapply(med_fits, function(f) lavaan::nobs(get(f)), numeric(1))
), "results/mediation_params.rds")
```

```{r sensitivity analysis - sequential ignorability, warning=FALSE}

sem_mediation_sensitivity <- function(model_syntax, data, m_var, y_var,
                                       rho_grid = seq(-0.9, 0.9, by = 0.05),
                                       estimator = "ML") {

  # baseline (rho = 0, lavaan's default) supplies the residual SDs used to
  # convert each candidate correlation into covariance units below
  fit0 <- sem(model_syntax, data = data, estimator = estimator)
  pe0 <- parameterestimates(fit0)
  var_m <- pe0$est[pe0$lhs == m_var & pe0$rhs == m_var & pe0$op == "~~"]
  var_y <- pe0$est[pe0$lhs == y_var & pe0$rhs == y_var & pe0$op == "~~"]
  sd_m <- sqrt(var_m); sd_y <- sqrt(var_y)

  purrr::map_dfr(rho_grid, function(rho) {
    cov_val <- rho * sd_m * sd_y
    # fix the mediator-outcome residual covariance at the value implied by
    # this rho, and let a, b, c re-estimate freely around that constraint
    sens_syntax <- paste0(model_syntax, "\n", m_var, " ~~ ", cov_val, "*", y_var, "\n")
    fit <- tryCatch(
      sem(sens_syntax, data = data, estimator = estimator, se = "standard"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit) || !lavInspect(fit, "converged")) {
      return(tibble(rho = rho, indirect = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
    }
    pe <- parameterestimates(fit)
    ind <- pe[pe$lhs == "indirect" & pe$op == ":=", ]
    tibble(rho = rho, indirect = ind$est, se = ind$se)
  })
}

find_tipping_rho <- function(sens_df) {
  sens_df <- sens_df %>% filter(!is.na(indirect)) %>% arrange(rho)
  sign_change <- which(diff(sign(sens_df$indirect)) != 0)
  if (length(sign_change) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  i <- sign_change[1]
  x1 <- sens_df$rho[i]; x2 <- sens_df$rho[i + 1]
  y1 <- sens_df$indirect[i]; y2 <- sens_df$indirect[i + 1]
  x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)  # linear interpolation to the zero crossing
}

plot_sensitivity <- function(sens_df, title) {
  tipping <- find_tipping_rho(sens_df)
  p <- ggplot(sens_df, aes(x = rho, y = indirect)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = if (!is.na(tipping)) paste0("Indirect effect = 0 at rho* = ", round(tipping, 2))
                    else "Indirect effect does not cross zero for rho in [-0.9, 0.9]",
         x = expression(rho ~ "(assumed mediator-outcome residual correlation)"),
         y = "Estimated indirect effect (a*b)") +
    theme_minimal()
  if (!is.na(tipping)) p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = tipping, linetype = "dotted", color = "firebrick")
  p
}

# 2020, detailed vs. limited (both studies pooled) - primary headline comparison
sens_det_2020 <- sem_mediation_sensitivity(
  model,
  data = df_both %>% filter(ConditionFeedback != "Control" & !(is.na(ConditionFeedback)) & ConditionFeedback != "Belief & Values-Tailored"),
  m_var = "Sureness_Diff", y_var = "ER0_Diff"
)
plot_sensitivity(sens_det_2020, "Detailed vs. Limited -> 2020 Denialism (Studies 1+2)")

# 2020, personalized vs. limited (Study 1 only - Study 2 has no Values-Tailored arm)

  m_var = "Sureness_Diff", y_var = "ER0_Diff"
)

# Summary: tipping-point rho* for each core comparison, for the manuscript text/table
sensitivity_summary <- tibble(
  comparison = c("Detailed vs. Limited -> 2020 (S1+S2)",
                 "Personalized vs. Limited -> 2020 (S1)",
                 "Detailed vs. Limited -> 2024 (S1+S2)",
                 "Personalized vs. Limited -> 2024 (S1)"),
  rho_star = c(find_tipping_rho(sens_det_2020),
               find_tipping_rho(sens_pers_2020),
               find_tipping_rho(sens_det_2024),
               find_tipping_rho(sens_pers_2024))
)
sensitivity_summary
```

```{r saving mediation plots - no, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
               labels = c("ConditionDet" = "Detailed Feedback", "Sureness_Diff" = "Change in Specific Claim", "ER0_Diff" = "Change in 2020 Denialism"))

dag2 <- dagify(Sureness_Diff ~ ConditionPers, 
               ER0_Diff ~ Sureness_Diff + ConditionPers, 
               labels = c("ConditionPers" = "Personalized Feedback", "Sureness_Diff" = "Change in Specific Claim", "ER0_Diff" = "Change in 2020 Denialism"))

# Combine the two models into one plot
ggdag(dag1) + ggdag(dag2)
```
